items.name: Android Studio
items.description: Official integrated development environment for building Android applications, providing code editing, debugging, emulation, and build tools based on IntelliJ IDEA.

items.name: AVPlayer
items.description: Apple framework class used to play and control audio and video media within iOS, macOS, and other Apple platform applications.

items.name: CocoaPods
items.description: Dependency manager for Swift and Objective-C projects that automates downloading, integrating, and managing third-party libraries in Xcode projects.

items.name: Cocos2d
items.description: Open-source framework for building 2D games and graphical applications, offering tools for rendering, physics, and animation across mobile and desktop platforms.

items.name: Combine
items.description: Apple framework for handling asynchronous and event-driven code using a declarative publisher/subscriber model, commonly paired with SwiftUI apps.

items.name: Flutter
items.description: Open-source UI toolkit from Google for building natively compiled applications for mobile, web, and desktop from a single Dart codebase.

items.name: Ionic
items.description: Open-source framework for building cross-platform mobile and desktop apps using standard web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, wrapped in native containers.

items.name: iOS
items.description: Apple's mobile operating system that powers iPhone devices, providing the platform and APIs on which mobile apps run.

items.name: React Native
items.description: Framework for building cross-platform mobile applications using JavaScript and React, rendering to native UI components on iOS and Android.

items.name: RxSwift
items.description: Reactive programming library for Swift that lets developers compose asynchronous and event-based code using observable sequences, based on the ReactiveX model.

items.name: Swift Charts
items.description: Apple framework for building data visualizations and charts declaratively within SwiftUI applications.

items.name: SwiftUI
items.description: Apple's declarative framework for building user interfaces across iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS using Swift.

items.name: UIKit
items.description: Apple's framework for building user interfaces on iOS and related platforms using an imperative, object-oriented approach, predating SwiftUI.

items.name: Universal Windows Platform
items.description: Microsoft platform for developing applications that run across multiple Windows device types, including PCs, tablets, and Xbox, using a common API set.

items.name: Xamarin
items.description: Microsoft framework for building cross-platform mobile applications using C# and .NET, compiling to native code for iOS and Android.

items.name: Xamarin.Forms
items.description: UI toolkit built on top of Xamarin that lets developers share a single C# codebase for user interfaces across iOS, Android, and Windows.
